mapper.insert:
insert into assist_task
id, task_id, user_id, video_url, status, max_retries, request_json, result_json, fail_reason, progress, progress_msg, created_time, updated_time, finished_time
values
#{id}, #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{videoUrl}, #{status}, #{maxRetries}, #{requestJson}, #{resultJson}, #{failReason}, #{progress}, #{progressMsg}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{finishedTime}
mapper.update: update assist_task set status = 'SUCCESS', progress = 100, progress_msg = '生成完成', result_json = #{resultJson}, finished_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId}
update assist_task set progress = #{progress}, progress_msg = #{msg}, updated_time = now(), status = 'PROCESSING' where task_id = #{taskId}
update assist_task set status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{reason}, updated_time = now(), finished_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId}
